Every year, the edelweiss renews itself & regrows from few stem cells. We at Himalaya constantly strive to learn about the power of plants to bring you innovative yet efficacious beauty products that will be able to protect your natural beauty. And Hence Youth eternity powered with the goodness of edelweiss was born. Made with a unique stem cell technology that helps regulate youth genes and improves your innate skin cell matrix Youth Eternity helps you age backwards.It helps in Defying ageing and revealing the natural beauty of your skin which will stay Young soft & Velvety. Our range promises to give you a plump, hydrated and Youthful radiance reducing visible signs of ageing like fine lines, wrinkles, sun damage and many more!
